notes.title: Lifesigns Soundtrack
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of the [i]Lifesigns[/i] official soundtrack. Allow Nameless Ghoul be your captain tonight and let the sound waves carry you into the Moving Sea with a hope For A Better Tomorrow!
﻿
OST comes as a free bonus for all owners of the main game.

notes.title: Lifesigns: "The Monster" DLC
notes.notes:
For all of you who read [i]Lifesigns[/i] and wondered "Hey, how did Maya even found out about all that stuff?" — rejoice! Our new DLC will provide all the answers you seek, and something more. New events, new questionable decisions and some new old friends. Or rather, [i]young[/i] old friends. Mirror universe had never been more mirror-y this time of year, right?

Jokes aside and plans up front: we got a whole new story on the way and a few new ideas at the ready. And not to spoil anything — it will have something to do with this DLC. We tend to make them so that any newcomer could read them as a standalone stories, without any knowledge of the previous installment, sure. But reading all of them adds so much more dimension.

So grab and enjoy it!

notes.title: Lifesigns of hope
notes.notes:
Our small developer team was born in Ukraine, as well as like its members. We tell stories about acceptance and about the battles with the darkness within, but we could hardly ever imagine that a day will come when darkness emerges from the outside. On February, 24 russian troops started to bomb our home. Our country. We share our fond memories and deep personal connection with a lot of cities that are now suffering from the war, but one of them is special, for it became a literal cradle for one of our stories. For a month this city and its people are enduring heavy fire and heavy losses, completely besieged by the enemy.

Our novel [i]Lifesigns[/i] was written in Mariupol. The heating main with the seventeen cats — the one described in the story — is located not far from the Kuprin street, a bit further is the park in which Mister Cat fought off the demon. Now every bit of it is wiped out of existense: the heating main, the park, probably even the cats. We are in debt to this city, so starting from February 24th, all proceeds from [i]Lifesigns[/i] sales will be directed to the aid for Mariupol's people.

Help them survive.
